scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm build:operations && pnpm --filter @roco/api --filter @roco/worker --filter @roco/dashboard build
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @roco/config build && pnpm --filter @roco/shared build && pnpm --filter @roco/seo-core build && pnpm --filter @roco/crawler build && pnpm --filter @roco/integrations build && pnpm --filter @roco/opportunities build && pnpm --filter @roco/llm build && pnpm --filter @roco/agents build && pnpm --filter @roco/workflow build && pnpm --filter @roco/db build && pnpm --filter @roco/testkit build
scripts.test:integration: pnpm build:packages && vitest run packages/db/test/migrations.integration.test.ts && vitest run tests/integration/opportunities.integration.test.ts && vitest run tests/integration/agents.integration.test.ts && vitest run tests/integration/workflow.integration.test.ts && vitest run tests/integration/control.integration.test.ts && vitest run tests/integration/reliability.integration.test.ts && vitest run tests/integration/integration-status.integration.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --recursive --if-present typecheck && pnpm exec tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
